subject: A brain waste-clearance gene altered how much poor sleep costs
script: From Agewell Brief: A brain waste-clearance gene altered how much poor sleep costs. New research links sleep quality, genetics, and Alzheimer's-related brain changes, suggesting a personalized approach to prevention. A gene involved in brain waste clearance may alter sleep's impact. Shorter sleep linked to faster grey matter loss in some variants. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
